AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Travel planning app that stores the user's trip itineraries (including trips taken in the past) and books flights. Operational Patterns: - To recall a past trip or the trip being planned, call searchItineraries; past versus upcoming is judged by the dates of each itinerary's days compared with today's date. - To plan a new trip, call getTravelInfo for recommended spots, then call saveItinerary with the chosen spots grouped by day. - To book a flight for a trip, call bookFlight with the departure and arrival cities and the date of travel. Constraints: - All dates use yyyy-MM-dd format, for example 2026-12-20. - Cities for bookFlight are Japanese city names such as 東京 or 札幌, not airport names or codes. - getTravelInfo returns fixed data and supports only a few area and month combinations, such as 北海道 in December; unsupported combinations return an error listing the supported ones. - Flight numbers and booking numbers are assigned by the app and must not be invented.
